2026_02_CIN_HOU.headline: Burrow’s protection meets Houston pressure while the Texans replace Nico Collins
2026_02_CIN_HOU.paragraph1: Cincinnati brings Joe Burrow into Houston after he finished the week as a full practice participant despite a back issue. The Texans’ bigger availability problem is Nico Collins, who is out with a hamstring injury, while Jadeveon Clowney and guard Ed Ingram are also unavailable. Cincinnati must keep Will Anderson Jr. and Danielle Hunter from wrecking passing downs; Houston has to redistribute Collins’ targets and stay efficient enough to prevent the Bengals from squeezing the field around C.J. Stroud.
2026_02_CIN_HOU.model_rationale: Cincinnati’s protection against Houston’s edge pressure and the Texans’ ability to replace Collins’ receiving volume are the clearest levers for sustaining efficient drives.
